rows.title: Each animals set opens only its own notifications, and asks the answers the data specification gives it
rows.detail: Germinal products and live animals are sibling sets in the animals frontend, and a notification belongs to the set that created it. Each set's entry guard reads the category stored on the notification and refuses a notification of the other category, so a trader can never view or change a germinal products notification through a live animals page, or the other way round. A notification stored before categories existed counts as live animals. Which answers each set asks comes from the notification data specification: an answer is asked in both sets unless the specification marks it for one, and where both ask it with different permitted values, each set offers its own list.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a germinal products notification through a live animals page shows the page not found page and changes nothing on the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-031; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-094)

Opening a live animals notification through a germinal products page shows the page not found page and changes nothing on the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-031)

A notification whose record holds no category opens, saves and submits in the live animals set, and opening it through a germinal products page shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, -p1-030, -p1-031; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-097)

Where the notification data specification marks an answer as applying to the animals journey alone, the germinal products page copied from that live animals page does not ask it; every other answer it asks is the one its live animals twin asks. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-003, -p1-004; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-007)
Where both sets ask an answer whose permitted values differ between them, each set's page offers that set's own list of values. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-005)
rows.notes: Two slices: the cross-set guard (req-1901) and the rule deciding which answers each set asks (req-2210). Both are this area's share of existing row inc-176, the germinal set's skeleton, which already holds them; the combiner keeps inc-176's id, theme germinal-products, repos, gate, dependsOn and externalDependsOn, and merges these criteria with the other areas' there, stating each once. The guard reads the category the backend stores and returns on the read, which the notification-record area's requirements in inc-176 build, so the guard is not observable apart from them. The cross-set check is built at the set mount, in the germinal set and the router the germinal-products theme already owns, so the live-animals flow folder the split-off journey-foundation theme owns is not edited; if the plan finds the live-animals entry guard itself must change, that change belongs on the journey-foundation branch and this row consumes it. Re-distil against the 26 November prototype: neither requirement changed in substance.

rows.title: The germinal journey follows the live animals journey without the additional details, county parish holding and permanent address steps
rows.detail: The germinal products set, mounted at /germinal-products, keeps the live animals set's step order, opening run, return rules, journey buttons and status strip, because its pages are copies of the live animals pages. Three steps never apply to germinal products: additional details, the county parish holding number and the permanent address. So the opening run goes from identification straight to arrival details, the consignment addresses page has only the party rows, and the overview has no additional details task. What the consignment is certified for has only one possible answer, so the draft is created holding it and nothing asks it.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification's journey pages are reached at /germinal-products/notifications/<reference>/<slug>, under the same slugs the live animals set uses. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-007, -p1-009, -p1-010; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-007)

Opening the additional details, CPH number or permanent address page of a germinal products notification shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-017, -p1-018; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-056)

A germinal products notification's overview shows the same tasks, in the same sections and the same order, as a live animals notification's overview, except that it holds no 'Additional details' task. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-143)

A germinal products notification's 'Consignment addresses' page shows the consignment party rows alone, with no CPH number row and no permanent address row. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-144)

When identification applies to a germinal products notification, the page after it in the opening run is arrival details. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-017, -p1-018; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-145)

Every germinal products journey page shows the status strip with the notification's status and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-086)

Every germinal products journey page ends with the same journey buttons, in the same order and with the same labels, as the live animals page it is copied from. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-014; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-146)

A germinal products draft is created holding 'Germinal products' as what the consignment is certified for, no germinal page asks it, and the germinal review shows 'Certified for' reading 'Germinal products' with no Change link. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019, -p1-020; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-147)
The high-risk plants frontend has no germinal set and no germinal page: its journey and its pages are unchanged. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)
rows.notes: One slice (req-1898), this area's share of existing row inc-182, which already holds it; the combiner keeps inc-182's id, theme germinal-products, repos, dependsOn and externalDependsOn and merges these criteria with the other areas' there, stating each once. c-274 (ruled by precedence): every set keeps the real path shape under its own base path, so no criterion states the prototype's flat paths. The opening-run criterion states only the step the set leaves out; where each other button goes is the live animals flow the copies are taken from, so no other criterion names a button destination. The germinal set's copies of the overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation come from the rows inc-182 already depends on. The certified-for value is set in the germinal set's own start, not in the shared stub create lifecycle the split-off manage-notifications theme owns. Re-distil against the 26 November prototype: the statement did not change in substance.

rows.title: End-to-end proof: a germinal products notification for bovine semen, from create to submitted
rows.detail: Every whole journey the tests walk today is a live animals one. This row walks a germinal products notification for bovine semen from create to submitted in the animals test project, and checks the review shows the answers given. It proves the germinal pages the other germinal rows build, so it lands after them.
acceptanceCriteria: A spec in the test suite's existing animals project, under tests/animals/e2e/germinal-products, walks a germinal products notification for bovine semen from create to submitted: the Netherlands as the country of origin, a total gross weight, a quantity and a number of packages, Frozen, Internal market for Breeding, donor identification entered once for the species, Port of Dover by Road with transit through Belgium, and a consignee chosen on the 'Consignment addresses' page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062, -p1-063, -p1-110)
Before declaring, the walk checks the germinal review page shows each answer it gave. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

The walk runs in the animals test project, under the project's existing browser configuration, with no new test project added. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062; repo:tests repo-tests-p8-152)
rows.notes: One slice (req-1899), this area's share of existing row inc-184, which already holds it; the combiner keeps inc-184's id, theme germinal-products, repos, dependsOn and open question, and merges this draft with the whole-journeys area's, stating the review check and project placement once. Tests only: every behaviour the walk exercises is built by the germinal rows it depends on, so its acceptance is observable once it lands, locally and in CI. The walk asserts no button destination. Re-distil against the 26 November prototype: the statement did not change.

splitOff.why: It changes the endings of the party pickers and the CPH number page, which theme consignment-parties owns, and that branch's inc-097 already built these endings (the permanent address page's endings sit on main); it was in the consignment-parties rows when the theme split off.
